描述_EN: they are also associated with several european renaissance potentates for whom they were status symbols, fashioned into robes and depicted in paintings of the time. this fragment is part of a group of chinese silks collected from christian church treasuries and believed to have been in europe since the time of their manufacture. the piece is thought to date from the period when the mongols ruled china as the yuan dynasty (1279-1368), as well as controlling a great part of asia. these small-scale patterned silks, which seem not to survive in china or central asia, were desirable and prized additions to the european decorative textile repertoire and reverently used as vestments and wrappings for holy relics.
描述_ZN: 它们还与一些欧洲文艺复兴时期的权贵有关，对他们来说，它们是地位的象征，被塑造成长袍，并被描绘在当时的绘画中。 这个片段是一组中国丝绸的一部分，这组丝绸是从基督教教会的宝库中收集的，据说从它们制造的时候就已经在欧洲了。 这件作品被认为是在蒙古人统治中国的元朝时期（1279-1368），同时也控制了亚洲的大部分地区。 这些小规模的花纹丝绸，在中国和中亚似乎都不存在，是欧洲装饰性纺织品的理想和珍贵的补充，被虔诚地用作法衣和圣物的包裹。
